content: {"like":["Enjoys strong visual and narrative hooks such as compelling trailers and twist endings","Values action-packed and suspenseful content, especially with international casts","Prefers films and shows that blend genres (e.g., horror with dark humor, seduction with betrayal)","Appreciates high production quality in special effects and acting","Likes original, low-budget productions that still deliver engaging stories"],"dislike":["Dislikes films that fail to live up to trailer hype or have confusing plots","Avoids slow, dimly-lit, underground settings that hinder storytelling","Prefers clear, well-structured narratives over muddled or cheated endings","Favors English-language or subtitled content over dubbed non-English versions","Is critical of weak stories that leave unresolved arcs or feel like a waste of money"]}
